rows.grounds: pañcaśuddhiṃ is the accusative object of vinā; vinā is indeclinable meaning without

items.question: What does worship without the five purifications become fit for?
premises: Such worship becomes fit for sorcery.
items.inference: The absence of the five purifications turns worship into something fit for sorcery.
uncertainties: The exact constituents of pañcaśuddhi are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Worship without the five purifications becomes fit for sorcery.
